test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan, 2024 Shift 1).
subject: general
question: What is the purpose of a search engine on the internet?

options.text: To create and edit documents online.
To search and retrieve relevant information from the web.
To network with people on social media platforms.

solution:
The correct answer is __**To search and retrieve relevant information from the web.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **To search and retrieve relevant information from the web** is the primary purpose of a search engine on the internet.
 
• Search engines use algorithms to index web pages and provide the most relevant results based on the user's query.
 
• Popular search engines include **Google, Bing, and Yahoo**, among others.
 
• They help users find websites, images, videos, and other content online.
 
• Advanced search features may include filters for date, type of content, and specific keywords.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Search engines use **web crawlers** to gather information from websites.
 
• They store data in an **index** to quickly retrieve relevant results.
 
• Search engine optimization (SEO) is a practice to improve the visibility of a website in search engine results.
 
• Search engines also offer features like **autocomplete** to assist users in finding information faster.
 
• Besides web pages, search engines can also index **images, videos, news articles, and academic papers**.
 
• Users can perform **advanced searches** using operators like quotes for exact phrases, minus sign to exclude words, and site: to search within a specific website.
